story: Primary recapitalisation of a Mexican specialised health insurer. New shares in the Dutch holdco for 49% (look-through about 27-30% of the opco). USD 22M, tranche 1 USD 10M as a convertible loan on signing, balance on SHCP/CNSF approval. Priced on restated book with a price adjustment to the independent actuarial review. Owners take no proceeds. Solvency 1.01-1.02x at the last reported month-end.
entities: Plan Seguro S.A. de C.V., Compañía de Seguros
